intro: Find inspiration for your next shared adventure.

auth.passwordHint: 12 to 1024 characters. Long passphrases are welcome.
auth.resetSent: If an active password account exists, we will send a reset link. Check local Mailpit.
auth.resetDone: Your password has changed. Log in again.
auth.draftWarning: Draft for local testing only — not ready for public launch.
auth.draftText: Your account is for testing Travel Buddy. Use test data. Do not publish other people’s data or unlawful content. We store a password hash; sessions last up to 7 days.
auth.draftMissing: Before public launch, add administrator and contact details, deletion and complaints rules, and obtain legal review.

errors.CSRF_INVALID: Refresh the page and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.RESET_INVALID: The link is invalid, expired or already used.
errors.UNKNOWN: The request failed. Please try again.

errors.GOOGLE_FAILED: Google sign-in failed. Try again; if it persists, check the integration configuration.
errors.GOOGLE_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED: Google has not verified your email address.
errors.GOOGLE_EMAIL_CONFLICT: An account with this email already exists. Use your previous sign-in method or reset your password. No accounts were linked.
errors.GOOGLE_REGISTRATION_REQUIRED: Go to registration and accept the terms first.
errors.GOOGLE_FLOW_INVALID: This sign-in attempt expired or was replaced. Start again.

profile.ready: Your profile and contact are ready for future participation.
profile.missingProfile: Complete your profile before future publishing or joining.
profile.missingContact: Add a contact before future publishing or joining.
profile.publicHint: These fields are public. Use plain text without HTML. Age is self-declared.
profile.contactsHint: Contacts are private. In the future they will only be shared with the organizer or an accepted participant of a shared trip.
profile.phoneHint: Only the number format is checked, not its existence or ownership.

errors.INVALID_AGE: Enter a whole age between 18 and 120.
errors.INVALID_BIO: Bio: up to 1000 characters, no HTML.
errors.INVALID_INSTAGRAM: Use 1–30 letters, digits, dots or underscores, not a URL.
errors.PROFILE_VERSION_CONFLICT: The profile changed in another tab. Your edits have been kept. Reload before editing again.
